An LSTM cell has three gates: a forget g.zh: 一个 LSTM 单元有三道门：遗忘门决定从细胞状态中擦除什么，输入门决定写入什么，输出门决定读出什么。拖动每个滑块，送入一段输入序列，观察细胞状态如何流动 —— 或者冻结不动。
An LSTM cell has three gates: a forget g.src: An LSTM cell has three gates: a forget gate decides what to erase from the cell state, an input gate decides what to write, and an output gate decides what to read. Drag each slider, feed an input sequence, and watch the cell state flow — or freeze in place.

@@T0@@~8 min@@T1@@@@T2@@Deep Learning ·.zh: @@T0@@约 8 分钟@@T1@@@@T2@@深度学习 · RNN · LSTM@@T3@@

Vanilla RNNs struggle with long-range de.zh: 朴素 RNN 难以处理长程依赖。梯度经过一连串 W@@T0@@⊤@@T1@@·diag(tanh') 连乘之后，要么消失，要么爆炸。Hochreiter 与 Schmidhuber 在 1997 年的洞见在于：让循环拥有自己的状态，并由@@T2@@门控@@T3@@ —— 即 [0, 1] 区间内的 sigmoid 值 —— 来更新该状态，而非通过矩阵乘法。
Vanilla RNNs struggle with long-range de.src: Vanilla RNNs struggle with long-range dependencies. Gradients multiplied through a chain of W⊤·diag(tanh') either vanish or explode. Hochreiter & Schmidhuber's 1997 insight: give the recurrence its own state that is updated by gates — sigmoid values in [0, 1] — instead of a matrix multiply.

The cell state becomes a conveyor belt..zh: 细胞状态由此成为一条传送带。在每个时间步，遗忘门做乘法，输入门做加法，而只有输出门决定将多少内容暴露为隐藏状态。
The cell state becomes a conveyor belt..src: The cell state becomes a conveyor belt. At each timestep, the forget gate multiplies, the input gate adds, and only the output gate decides how much to expose as the hidden state.

Scenario · sentiment flip (\"brilliant ..zh: 场景 · 情感反转（「brilliant ... bad」）

Scenario · sustained signal + noise.zh: 场景 · 持续信号 + 噪声

Input spikes at t=3 and t=7 · solid line.zh: 输入在 t=3 与 t=7 处出现尖峰 · 实线 = 细胞状态 c_t · 虚线 = 隐藏状态 h_t
Input spikes at t=3 and t=7 · solid line.src: Input spikes at t=3 and t=7 · solid line = cell state c_t · dashed = hidden state h_t

@@T0@@Remember forever@@T1@@ — f=1, i=0..zh: @@T0@@永久记忆@@T1@@ —— f=1, i=0。细胞状态在首个输入之后便冻结。LSTM 正是以这种方式保存长程信息。
@@T0@@Remember forever@@T1@@ — f=1, i=0..src: Remember forever — f=1, i=0. The cell state freezes after the first input. This is how LSTMs hold long-range information.

@@T0@@Forget always@@T1@@ — f=0. Every t.zh: @@T0@@始终遗忘@@T1@@ —— f=0。每个时间步都擦除。效果类似于 tanh 饱和的朴素 RNN。
@@T0@@Forget always@@T1@@ — f=0. Every t.src: Forget always — f=0. Every timestep erases. Like vanilla RNN with tanh saturation.

@@T0@@Overwrite always@@T1@@ — f=0, i=1..zh: @@T0@@始终覆写@@T1@@ —— f=0, i=1。细胞状态只跟踪最新的输入。
@@T0@@Overwrite always@@T1@@ — f=0, i=1..src: Overwrite always — f=0, i=1. Cell state tracks the latest input only.

@@T0@@The key equation.@@T1@@ c_t = f_t.zh: @@T0@@关键方程。@@T1@@ c_t = f_t · c_{t-1} + i_t · c̃_t。遗忘门是一条@@T2@@乘法式@@T3@@路径（不含矩阵乘法），因此经由细胞状态的梯度既不会爆炸也不会消失 —— 它们按 f_t 缩放，而在记忆重要时，网络会学会让 f_t 保持在接近 1 的数值。
@@T0@@The key equation.@@T1@@ c_t = f_t.src: The key equation. c_t = f_t · c_{t-1} + i_t · c̃_t. The forget gate is a multiplicative path (no matrix multiply), so gradients through the cell state don't explode or vanish — they scale by f_t, which the network learns to keep near 1 when memory matters.

GRU (Cho 2014) merges the forget and inp.zh: GRU（Cho，2014）将遗忘门与输入门合并为一个「更新」门，并把 c 与 h 合并。参数更少，精度往往相当。到 2026 年，在二者之间取舍基本属于个人偏好；在大多数任务上二者都被 Transformer 远远超越。但在微型设备与流式场景中，它们仍是主力。
GRU (Cho 2014) merges the forget and inp.src: GRU (Cho 2014) merges the forget and input gates into one "update" gate, and merges c and h. Fewer parameters, often comparable accuracy. Picking between them in 2026 is mostly personal preference; both are dwarfed by Transformers on most tasks. But for tiny devices and streaming, they are still the workhorses.

BPTT and the vanishing-gradient story.zh: BPTT 与梯度消失的故事

Training an RNN is backprop-through-time.zh: 训练 RNN 即沿时间反向传播（BPTT）：将循环展开，视其为权重共享的前馈网络，并沿时间反向传播梯度。朴素 RNN 致命的问题在于：每回退一步，梯度都会乘以同一个循环映射的 Jacobian。若该 Jacobian 的谱半径 < 1，梯度将指数级消失；若 > 1，则会爆炸。
Training an RNN is backprop-through-time.src: Training an RNN is backprop-through-time (BPTT): unroll the recurrence, treat it like a feed-forward net with shared weights, and propagate gradients backward through time. The fatal problem in a plain RNN: at every step backward, the gradient is multiplied by the same Jacobian of the recurrent map. If that Jacobian's spectral radius is < 1, gradients vanish exponentially; if > 1, they explode.

Why LSTMs fix it: the cell state $c_t$ c.zh: LSTM 为何能解决这一问题：细胞状态 $c_t$ 通过 $c_t = f_t \odot c_{t-1} + i_t \odot g_t$ 向前传递信息。其 Jacobian $\partial c_t / \partial c_{t-1} = f_t$ 恰恰就是遗忘门的取值 —— 一个位于 $(0,1)$ 区间、可逐步学习的标量。当模型想要记住时，$f_t \approx 1$，梯度便原封不动地回流。@@T0@@这才是 LSTM 能够被训练的真正原因。@@T1@@
Why LSTMs fix it: the cell state $c_t$ c.src: Why LSTMs fix it: the cell state $c_t$ carries information forward via $c_t = f_t \odot c_{t-1} + i_t \odot g_t$. The Jacobian $\partial c_t / \partial c_{t-1} = f_t$ is just the forget-gate value — a per-step learnable scalar in $(0,1)$. When the model wants to remember, $f_t \approx 1$ and the gradient flows back unchanged. That's the actual reason LSTMs train.

Peephole / ConvLSTM / xLSTM.zh: 窥孔式 / ConvLSTM / xLSTM 变体

@@T0@@Peephole LSTM.@@T1@@ Gates also se.zh: @@T0@@Peephole LSTM。@@T1@@ 各门同时也能看到细胞状态 $c_{t-1}$。在长依赖任务上精度提升有限。
@@T0@@Peephole LSTM.@@T1@@ Gates also se.src: Peephole LSTM. Gates also see the cell state $c_{t-1}$. Marginal accuracy on long-dependency tasks.

@@T0@@GRU.@@T1@@ One fewer gate; one few.zh: @@T0@@GRU。@@T1@@ 少一道门；少一个状态；在多数任务上表现相当；成本更低。
@@T0@@GRU.@@T1@@ One fewer gate; one few.src: GRU. One fewer gate; one fewer state; comparable on most tasks; cheaper.

@@T0@@ConvLSTM.@@T1@@ Replace the matmul.zh: @@T0@@ConvLSTM。@@T1@@ 以卷积替代矩阵乘法；适用于时空数据（雷达、视频、卫星时间序列）。
@@T0@@ConvLSTM.@@T1@@ Replace the matmul.src: ConvLSTM. Replace the matmuls with convolutions; useful for spatio-temporal data (radar, video, satellite time series).

@@T0@@xLSTM (2024).@@T1@@ Updated gates.zh: @@T0@@xLSTM（2024）。@@T1@@ 更新后的门控 + 矩阵值记忆；可进一步扩展；在语言建模上与小型 Mamba 不相上下。
@@T0@@xLSTM (2024).@@T1@@ Updated gates.src: xLSTM (2024). Updated gates + matrix-valued memory; scales further; competitive with small Mambas on language modelling.

When to reach for an LSTM in 2026.src: When to reach for an LSTM in 2026

Streaming inference where state-space ca.zh: 状态空间承载逐步都至关重要的流式推理（低延迟语音、边缘端时间序列预测）。
Streaming inference where state-space ca.src: Streaming inference where state-space carrying matters per step (low-latency speech, time-series forecasting at the edge).

Tiny embedded devices where Transformers.zh: Transformer 的 KV cache 过于昂贵的微型嵌入式设备。
Tiny embedded devices where Transformers.src: Tiny embedded devices where Transformers' KV cache is too expensive.

As a baseline before reaching for @@T0@@.zh:
在长时段时间序列上转向 @@T0@@Mamba@@T1@@ 或
        @@T2@@PatchTST@@T3@@ 之前，作为基线。
As a baseline before reaching for @@T0@@.src: As a baseline before reaching for Mamba or PatchTST on long-horizon time series.

Beyond that, modern Transformers and SSM.zh: 除此之外，现代 Transformer 与 SSM 占据主导。LSTM 之所以沿用至今，是因为它是讲解@@T0@@梯度消失问题@@T1@@最清晰的教学模型，也是「记忆」被显式表达为门控状态的最简模型。
Beyond that, modern Transformers and SSM.src: Beyond that, modern Transformers and SSMs dominate. The LSTM lives on as the cleanest pedagogical model for the vanishing-gradient problem and the simplest model where "memory" is an explicit, gated state.

Companion: @@T0@@Mamba / SSMs@@T1@@ · @@.zh: 配套阅读：@@T0@@Mamba / SSM@@T1@@ · @@T2@@梯度消失@@T3@@ · @@T4@@PatchTST 预测@@T5@@。
